title: NA60031: Mechanics Of Floating Bodies
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Types of ships. Principal dimensions and form coefficients. Classification
Societies and statutory regulations. Ship hydrostatics. Stability and trim of
free floating bodies. Ship measurements : deadweight, capacity and tonnage.
Structural members of a ship, ships longitudinal strength. Ship resistance
components and their estimation. Propeller and rudder. Ship hull vibration.
